title: Morningstar to Congress: Investor Success Hinges on Lower Costs, Greater Transparency
summary: Check out Morningstar Managing Director Jeffrey Ptak's written testimony submitted to the US House Financial Services Committee’s Subcommittee on Capital Markets for its June 25 hearing titled “From Wall Street to Main Street: The Future of How America Invests.”
